notes.title: Map marking and bug fixes
notes.content:
This build adds the ability to mark the current room so you can find it later. Click "Mark Room" when the map is open to mark a room. 

Also, minor bug fixes - I've once again changed how floating points are loaded from disk. Let me know if this causes any issues. 

Cheers, 
Isaac

notes.title: More key rebinding options
notes.content:
You can now rebind the keys for: 
- Move Left
- Move Right
- Look Up
- Look Down
- Drop Through (a platform) 
- Menu Navigate Up
- Menu Navigate Down

Minor fix: Orbited orbs orbit speed is affected by the `MultiplySpeed` instruction. 

Also, I've added a new instruction in the `Senses` section: `OrbActive(Orb orb)`. 
This returns "true" if the input orb is active, and "false" if the input orb has been destroyed / it's lifespan has run out. 

Cheers, 
Isaac

notes.title: Fixed comma in floating point number string issue
notes.content:
Okay this patch should fix the previous patch for those of you having issues with the floating point number parse issue. 

*Now* I'm pretty sure this is going to work lol. 

If you have further issues, please let me know. 

Best, 
Isaac

notes.title: Fixed save loading issue, again
notes.content:
It looks like some players are still experiencing issues loading into their saves. 
I've released another update addressing a different bug which could prevent save loading. 

It's possible your save location will be reset to (0,0), but you can use the "reset position" button in the pause menu to fix this. 

Email me or post in the discussion forums if you're still experiencing issues. 

Best,
Isaac

notes.title: Fixed save loading issue
notes.content:
This update *should* fix the save loading issues some players are experiencing. 
The game should load normally. 

If you were experiencing these issues, it's possible your character will spawn in the wall or off the map the first time you load back in. I've added a button in the pause menu "Reset Position" which should move you back into the map then the game should continue as normal. 

Please email me or post on the steam discussion forums if you're continuing to experience issues. 

Shoutout to Zinal on the discussion forum for pointing out the cause of the issue!

notes.title: Diagnostics update
notes.content:
It seems some players are having issues loading into their saves, I've enabled cloud diagnostics in order to hopefully help me pinpoint the cause of these issues. 

Sorry for the difficulties. 

Best, 
Isaac

notes.title: Arcane Assembly out now!
notes.content:
Arcane Assembly has released! Thanks so much for your support, and I hope you all enjoy the game  😊

- Isaac

notes.title: Arcane Assembly coming out May 17th!
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that Arcane Assembly will release May 17th! 
I've been working on this project on and off for almost two years, and I can't wait to finally see it released! 
I appreciate everyone's patience as I finish up the game, and hope the end result was worth the wait. 

Best, 
Isaac

notes.title: Next fest over
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who played the Arcane Assembly demo during the steam next fest! 
I got a ton of great feedback which I'm starting to incorporate into the game as I move towards release. 
In case you didn't get a chance to play the demo during the next fest, I'll be leaving the demo up till tomorrow around noon, but after that it will no longer be available. 

Thanks again for all the support! I'm hoping to have the full release by the end of the year. 

Cheers, 
Isaac

notes.title: Demo is out!
notes.content:
The demo for Arcane Assembly is available now! 

I'm currently working on the final area of the game, so I hope that the full release should be in the next few months, by the end of 2023. 

Thanks so much for the support, and I'm very excited to hear your thoughts on the game!

- Isaac
